proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5232 *jījja explicitly gives Hindi jījī/jijjī elder sister. Bundeli jījhi/jīžī matches this nursery kin family with aspiration or frication retained; it is not a uniquely reconstructible inherited stem. Exact survey form jījʰi is preserved.
